title: Whobela: Ask Someone Out
shortDescription: Ask someone out with a page made just for them. Know the moment they say yes.
fullDescription:
Whobela is the easiest way to ask someone out. Instead of sending "hey, want to go out sometime?", you build a small, personal page that asks the question properly — and you find out the second they answer.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Write your question. "Coffee this Saturday?" "Dinner on Friday?" Anything you like, in your own words.
2. Make it yours. Pick a theme, choose the emoji, set what the YES button says, and add a playful No button if you want one.
3. Share one private link. Send it by text, WhatsApp, Instagram DM — however you normally talk to them.
4. Get the answer instantly. The moment they tap YES, your phone buzzes.

They never need to download anything or make an account. They just open the link and answer.

MORE THAN A YES OR NO

When someone says yes, Whobela keeps going. They pick a day that suits them from the times you made available, choose what they are in the mood for — coffee, dinner, a film — and can leave you a message and their contact. So you do not just get a yes. You get a plan.

FIRST DATE IDEAS, BUILT IN

Coffee, dinner, a walk, the cinema, Sunday breakfast: you offer the options, and the answer tells you which one they actually want. No more "so when are you free?" back and forth.

WHY PEOPLE USE IT

• Asking in person is hard, and a plain text message is easy to ignore
• A page you actually made shows effort, and effort is the point
• The scheduling is already built in
• Everyone who answers is collected in one inbox

WHOBELA IS NOT A DATING APP

Dating apps introduce you to strangers. Whobela is for someone you already know — a crush, a friend you have been thinking about differently, a colleague, or your partner of ten years who deserves a proper invitation to date night.

FREE

Whobela is free. There is no trial, no subscription and no payment of any kind.

GOOD FOR

Asking someone out • First dates • Date night invitations • Anniversaries • Valentine's Day • Long-distance couples • Asking your partner on a proper date again

Your page lives at your own link, and you can take it offline whenever you want. Adults only, 18+.
